verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a cloud platform, but the evidence pack documents no first-party cron or scheduled-job feature. A community user says scheduled tasks are 'the missing bit' and describes running a permanent scheduler app as a user-side workaround, which earns no credit. Restart policies, sleeping Sprites and one-off `fly machine run` are adjacent features or one-off actions, not recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
